name: gevfit
expr: [p1, c1] = gevfit(x1); p2 = gevfit(x2); p3 = gevfit(x3); err1_k = abs(p1(1) - 0.2); err1_s = abs(p1(2) - 1.0); err1_m = abs(p1(3) - 0.5); err2_k = abs(p2(1) + 0.2); err3_k = abs(p3(1));
comment: Sig: [parmhat, parmci] = gevfit(x[, alpha]). 3-parameter GEV MLE with PWM initial guess (Hosking-Wallis-Wood 1985: k ≈ 7.8590c + 2.9554c², σ via Γ(1+k)·(1-2^{-k}), μ via b0 - σ(1-Γ(1+k))/k), then 3-D Newton-Raphson on log-likelihood with FD gradient/Hessian and feasibility-guarded backtracking. CI via observed Fisher information (3×3 FD-Hessian inverse), Wald with log transform on σ, linear on k and μ (MATLAB convention). Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on Frechet (k>0), Reverse-Weibull (k<0), and Gumbel-max (k=0) deterministic samples to 3-4 sig figs. KNOWN GAPs: none — censoring + freq deferred (rare for extreme value analysis).
